communicationContent.description: This file stores structured communication exercises. It is intentionally separate from the website interface. Note: app.js currently holds its own copy of this content so the site works when opened directly from disk. Keep the scenarios below in sync with app.js.

scenario.title: Meeting someone new at work
scenario.prompt: A new colleague introduces themselves: "Hi, I'm Alex. I don't think we've met before." Respond naturally and keep the conversation going.

scenario.title: Asking a teacher for clarification
scenario.prompt: Your teacher has explained an assignment, but you still do not understand one part. Ask for clarification without sounding abrupt.

scenario.title: Helping a customer
scenario.prompt: A customer asks whether you can help them find something. Respond professionally and guide the conversation.

scenario.title: Starting a conversation
scenario.prompt: You are at an event and notice someone you have not spoken to before. Start a friendly conversation.
